narrow: The original wording incorrectly makes local randomization and monotonicity imply rigidity of the larger unrestricted proxy fiber.  A counterexample takes uniform proxies, randomized treatment, no type 3, and response weights \(1/5,3/10,0,1/2\): every observed cell is positive, but rank-one proxy tables admit arbitrary incident splits and hence different PN/PS values.  The corrected claim states the classical formula on the restricted submodel and only asserts agreement with the unrestricted fiber when that fiber is independently rigid.

Repair the conditional bridge to assume theta in F_A(p,m) and singleton T_A(p,m), then conclude that T_A's unique element is the displayed pair.
